title: Driven Quantum Stars as Controlled Primitives for Real-Time Spin Dynamics
summary: Quantum advantage in real-time spin dynamics should be assessed against the strongest relevant classical substitutes, not merely against the qubit nature of the microscopic system. We develop a physics-based diagnostic for this boundary by reducing a qubit spin model to a spin-Landau--Lifshitz (LL) classical sector and organizing the residual quantum sector as controlled corrections. The control parameter is graph coordination: we study a spin star with \(d\) leaves and \(O(1/d)\) hub--leaf couplings. In its homogeneous form the star benchmarks the transition from LL-substitutable dynamics…
